detail.longDescription: I am not messing with you. I did a couple longer codex sessions in the past week over several different projects and there were genuine moments of 'I am drawing an actual blank.. can you tell me what it was that we were supposed to do next' with a tinge of holy crap I can't add basic two facts together. Some background. I was playing with some forms of llms for ..2 years now, but only more recently ( past 3 months or so ) with codex. I know that the basic approach is to treat mind like a muscle, but I am asking more specifically what you are doing to nullify the decline. It is just that I am fried at the end. It is that sometimes I go so far so fast I am not even sure I learn anything along the way.
